title: Bleeding Enchantment
description: Bleeding (but better) enchantment for axes that, you guessed it, applies bleeding "effect" on the target.
body:
## Why is it better

I'm sure you've seen a lot of bleeding mods/packs but this one isn't just a renamed poison. Bleeding makes you unable to heal and instead take damage equal to the amount you would have healed.

### Levels
 - I: 2 seconds of bleeding, 25% chance of applying effect on hit
 - II: 5 seconds of bleeding, 50% chance of applying effect on hit
 - III: 10 seconds of bleeding, 75% chance of applying effect on hit

**Remember! You have to reenter the world to make the enchantment work! Reloading isn't enough!**

**dm me on Discord if you want to suggest a feature, ask for something or just tell me my packs suck - jestemlag*
